title: World Champion and Worker: Brandon McNulty Can Only Joke about Getting Pulls From Tadej Pogačar
content:
'Maybe Tadej will have to ride for me': Brandon McNulty keeps the rainbow jersey in Team UAE for a third year but he's in no doubt who the boss will be in 2027.

Read the full article at World Champion and Worker: Brandon McNulty Can Only Joke about Getting Pulls From Tadej Pogačar on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
